description: Fixed query set for the golden-parity search-quality harness (tempdoc: sandbox release validation). Run against the SciFact eval corpus on the dev stack at candidate-qualification time via gen_golden_parity.py to produce the per-candidate golden-parity.json baseline. 'semantic' entries are deliberate paraphrases of SciFact scientific-claim topics chosen so BM25-only (lexical) retrieval is expected to struggle on vocabulary mismatch, specifically exercising the dense/hybrid leg — this is the class of query that would have caught the A.1 dense-dead bug (hybrid results collapsing toward BM25-only) instantly at parity-check time.
